title: VictoryHoldBroken
description: The coalition's victory hold broke (CONTRACTS §6; GAMEPLAY §9; ECONOMY EC-9; NX-412 part 4): its share of strategic nodes fell below campaign.victory_node_frac. Not emitted when the campaign ends during the hold. Public, like VictoryHoldStarted.

node_id.description: The hold node the coalition lost on this tick (the lowest id when it lost more than one).
